references.text: The context for God's promise to place curses on the enemies comes after Israel returns to the Lord
The curses mentioned here are the same ones God threatened to bring upon Israel if they were disobedient, but which will now fall on their enemies
God's promise to Abraham to curse those who curse his descendants
Balaam's prophecy that whoever curses Israel will be cursed
Isaiah's prophecy that no weapon forged against Israel shall prosper, and that God will judge those who accuse His people
Jeremiah's prophecy that all who devour Israel will themselves be devoured, and their enemies will go into captivity
Zephaniah's prophecy of God's judgment on Moab and Ammon for their mockery of God's people
